item.title: SW Portland apartment tenants claim new bike lane project would limit parking
item.description: Residents of a low-income apartment building in Portland are concerned that a proposed bike lane project on SW Alder Street will further limit the already scarce parking in the area.

item.title: Oregon House passes bill restricting immigration authorities in hospitals
item.description: Amid the Trump administration's crackdown on immigration, Oregon House lawmakers passed a bill on Monday that would restrict federal immigration authorities in hospitals in an effort to protect patient rights.

item.title: Oregon Republicans file lawsuit against moving gas tax to May ballot
item.description: A group of Republican lawmakers have filed a lawsuit to block a gas tax vote in May, claiming the Democrats' vote and the governor's approval to move it to May violates the referendum process.

item.title: What led to that deadly Safe Rest Village pod fire? Portland firefighters weigh in
item.description: A person died in a fire at the Safe Rest Village pod in North Portland, and the cause is still under investigation, while the Portland Fire and Rescue is investigating the safety precautions of the units.

item.title: Latino councilor told to repeat 'in English' in Metro Council meeting, sparking backlash
item.description: During a Metro Council work session, a Latino councilor was asked to "say that in English" while he was already speaking English, sparking backlash and prompting an apology from the councilor who made the comment.
